title: S2 bench report, version 1
description: What a hardware-in-the-loop or actuator bench emits when a run finishes. The connector turns one of these into objects, links and governed actions in S2. Enumerations match the drone-engineering ontology pack; changing one there is a breaking change here.

contract.description: Contract identifier and version. A connector refuses anything it does not know.

testRunId.description: Primary key of the TestRun in S2. The bench owns this identifier.

bench.description: Which bench or rig ran it.

logUri.description: Object-store URI of the raw logs. High-rate signals stay in files; only the verdict and the anomalies enter the ontology.

buildId.description: The SoftwareBuild under test. Must already exist in S2.

droneKey.description: The CommercialDrone the run executed on. Must already exist in S2.

verifies.description: Requirements this run verifies. Each must already exist in S2.

durationS.description: Length of the flagged window, in seconds.

subsystemId.description: Subsystem the fault is attributed to. Supply it with rootCause to have the connector confirm the anomaly; omit both to leave it OPEN for a person.
